copy.headline: Closed for Something Bigger

copy.body: The shutters are down at Pittsy’s Book. This week, Three Dreaded Snake has a more important arrival to attend to. copy.headline: The Road Narrows
copy.deck: Five weeks remain. A place in the tournament is the next prize.
copy.body: The scoreboards are settled; the league is not. Seven teams share 5–4, and the line between seventh and eighth is already separating identical records. Dr. Duckhook has a lead, not a guarantee. ObiWan Jacoby and Three Dreaded Snake have ground to recover; The LLC and Mud Dogs cannot afford to waste the remaining road. Five weeks stand between this crowded table and the postseason. The next victory will matter to more than the two teams playing for it.
